heroImageAlt: Hustle Hive founders Gavin Copland and Kieron Davis in Darlington
heroSubtitle: Building futures, one skill at a time
missionText: Hustle Hive CIC empowers people of all ages through hands-on learning, enterprise and wellbeing. We provide alternative provision for young people, creative spaces for homeschool families, and skills, mentoring and resources for adults to launch businesses. By combining entrepreneurship, innovation and mindfulness we help our community grow in confidence, resilience and opportunity.
visionText: To create a vibrant community hub where enterprise, education, and wellbeing connect, inspiring young people and adults alike to learn by doing, build their futures, and thrive together.

values.title: Inclusive Community
values.text: We believe in being a fully inclusive community of aspiration where a person's past decisions do not dictate their future opportunities.

values.title: Personalised Support
values.text: We believe that people of all ages and backgrounds have the right to a personalised offer which instills aspiration, entrepreneurship, physical and emotional resilience in a nurturing environment.

values.title: Hands-on Learning
values.text: We believe the route to self-development and self-actualisation is through real hands-on experiences where people create, build, test and grow.

safeguarding.heading: Safeguarding & policies
safeguarding.intro: How we keep children, young people and adults safe across all of Hustle Hive's work, and the policies we follow.
safeguarding.leadHeading: Safeguarding is central to everything we do
points: All staff in regulated activity have the appropriate recruitment and safeguarding checks, completed and recorded.
Staff are trained to respond to disclosures, child-on-child concerns, online safety, exploitation, radicalisation and allegations or low-level concerns.
Key Stages are supported separately. Our adult community programmes run after the school day, and adults and young people never cross over.
Visitors, contractors, site access and community-based learning are controlled and risk assessed.
Procedures follow Keeping Children Safe in Education and Working Together to Safeguard Children.
health: Practical learning is central to what we do, so safety is part of how we work, not just a policy in a folder. Access to equipment like 3D printers, heat presses, cutting machines and craft tools is matched to each learner's age, competence and individual risk assessment.
We hold risk assessments and safe operating procedures for all practical activities, plus fire, first-aid and off-site arrangements.
online: Our learner laptops are managed using classroom.cloud (by NetSupport), a classroom management and safeguarding platform. It allows our staff to support learners during sessions, view screens, restrict websites and flag concerning online activity, so we can respond quickly.
Monitoring only takes place on Hustle Hive devices during sessions.
